output.summary: The 98.1% figure is an artifact of the KPI definition, which lets a revised promised date replace the original. Revisions rose about 5x right after the bonus began at each center. Northgate and Riverside jumped in March 2026. Pell Junction stayed flat until July, when its bonus eligibility began. Capacity-coded and late-entered revisions rose, and few customers were notified. Brightwell's receiving logs show on-time against the original date fell from 87% to 81%, while the scorecard says 98.4%. RouteWise did not drive the gain: Northgate jumped before its go-live. Complaints were already up 36% before the portal launched. Driver vacancy is only associated with revisions and is confounded by lane mix. Suspend the claim, recompute against original dates, and re-base the incentive. Do not launch the campaign or raise the bonus.
